run.summary: Run completed with two escalations: one policy/questionnaire conflict on data residency, one procurement precondition unmet.

steps.title: Ingest & route
steps.summary: Source documents validated and routed to per-source Chroma + BM25 collections.
steps.rationale: All sources passed integrity checks. Row-targeted matrix loaded for downstream agents.

steps.title: IT Security determination
steps.summary: Policy over questionnaire conflict on data residency (EU-only policy vs. US-hosted vendor claim).
steps.rationale: Policy precedence applied. Escalation raised to human reviewer per Context Contract §3.

steps.title: Legal determination
steps.summary: Contractual posture aligns with standard MSA template; no redlines required.
steps.rationale: Vendor terms fall within pre-approved posture band.

steps.title: Procurement determination
steps.summary: Precondition unmet — procurement matrix shows no signed SOW for the current fiscal year.
steps.rationale: Escalated rather than blocked; SOW can be resolved outside the pipeline.

steps.title: Checklist assembly
steps.summary: Bundle composed with authority weighting; escalated items preserved in null-passthrough state.
steps.rationale: No silent-swallow. Escalated upstream items remain escalated downstream.

steps.title: Checkoff
steps.summary: Final determination: escalated. Two items require human disposition before the run can close as complete.
steps.rationale: Run ends in escalated state per design — no fabricated 'complete' output.
